metadata.title: GenUI Playground
metadata.description: POC: AI-generated UI with json-render, shadcn/ui, and Gemini

playground.title: GenUI Playground
playground.subtitle: Describe an interface — the model streams a JSONL spec that renders with the shadcn catalog.
playground.emptyState: The generated UI will render here.
playground.jsonDialogDescription: Paste a json-render spec (root + elements). It is saved as a new history entry.
playground.jsonInvalidJson: That is not valid JSON — check the syntax.
playground.jsonInvalidSpec: Valid JSON, but not a renderable spec: it needs a string "root", a non-empty "elements" object containing it, and every element must have a string "type".
playground.jsonCopyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard

notFound.title: UI not found
notFound.description: This link points to a UI that is not in this browser's history — it may have been deleted, or it was created in another browser.

errors.slugInvalid: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens
errors.slugTaken: That slug is already used by another UI

promptScope.addAll: Add all {count} instances to prompt scope

list.classNotCompiled: No compiled rule — this may not be a valid utility class.

instance.structureNote: Structure edits apply to all {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} (shared template)
instance.readonly: Read-only — expressions like $cond or $template cannot be edited directly; use the Actions tab

picker.title: Insert component
picker.description: Pick a component to add to the layout.

instructions.bolder: Increase the visual weight and prominence of this element with stronger typography and higher contrast.
instructions.quieter: Make this element more understated and subtle with lighter, lower-contrast styling.
instructions.polish: Refine the copy of this element for clarity, tone, and impact.
instructions.colorize: Improve the color treatment of this element so it fits a cohesive palette.
instructions.distill: Condense this element to its essential message — shorter, tighter copy.
instructions.layout: Improve the layout, spacing, and alignment around this element for better balance.

historyDrawer.title: History
historyDrawer.description: Your last {count} generations, stored in this browser.
historyDrawer.emptyState: No generations yet — create one to build your history.

quota.title: Rate limit reached
quota.description: The current model hit its request limit. Switch to another model and your last request will be retried automatically.

service.title: Model service unavailable
service.description: The model did not respond, so it may be temporarily unavailable. Switch to another model and your last request will be retried automatically.
service.noSpec: The model did not return a usable spec.
service.noChanges: The model returned no usable changes to the spec.
